content:
ACA Group is the new member of BUILT CoLAB with the unanimous approval of BUILT CoLAB members present at the 3rd General Meeting of the Association.

The company, founded in 1982, is today one of the most relevant Portuguese and international players in the construction sector. Focused on dynamic, innovative, and ambitious management, the ACA Group is the protagonist of a unique path, built step by step, both through growth for other countries and for other business areas.

It develops its activities in various geographies with a strong sense of social and environmental responsibility, seeking to create value for all stakeholders.
